tools.name: startCrazyEggSignup
tools.description: Open the Crazy Egg signup form, prefilled with the provided details. Opening the form has no side effects: the user must click Register, which sends a confirmation email, and the account is only created after the user follows the emailed link and submits the final form.

email.description: Work email address; the signup confirmation link is sent here

site.description: Production website URL to analyze, e.g. example.com
